questions.question: Although abiding in a material body, the living entity remains apart from the reactions of the modes, similar to what?

options.text: The sun remaining aloof from its reflection on water

questions.explanation: "He remains apart from the reactions of the modes, although abiding in a material body, just as the sun remains aloof from its reflection on water." (SB 3.27.1)

questions.question: When the soul identifies his body as the self under the spell of false ego, what does he think?

options.text: That he is the proprietor of everything
That he is a servant of God

questions.explanation: "By the influence of false ego he thinks that he is the proprietor of everything." (SB 3.27.2)

questions.question: Why does the conditioned soul transmigrate into different species of life, higher and lower?

options.text: Because of his association with the modes of material nature
By the will of the demigods

questions.explanation: "The conditioned soul therefore transmigrates into different species of life, higher and lower, because of his association with the modes of material nature." (SB 3.27.3)

questions.question: Although a living entity is transcendental to material existence, why does his material condition not cease?

options.text: Because of his mentality of lording it over material nature

questions.explanation: "Because of his mentality of lording it over material nature, his material existential condition does not cease, and just as in a dream, he is affected by all sorts of disadvantages." (SB 3.27.4)

questions.question: It is the duty of every conditioned soul to engage his polluted consciousness in what?

options.text: Very serious devotional service with detachment

questions.explanation: "It is the duty of every conditioned soul to engage his polluted consciousness, which is now attached to material enjoyment, in very serious devotional service with detachment." (SB 3.27.5)

questions.question: In executing devotional service, how should one see every living entity?

options.text: Equally, without enmity towards anyone yet without intimate connections

questions.explanation: "In executing devotional service, one has to see every living entity equally, without enmity towards anyone yet without intimate connections with anyone." (SB 3.27.7)

questions.question: How should a devotee see his own self upon realizing freedom from false ego?

options.text: Just as he sees the sun in the sky

questions.explanation: "Thus realizing freedom from false ego, one should see his own self just as he sees the sun in the sky." (SB 3.27.10)

questions.question: Though a devotee appears merged in the material elements and senses, he is understood to be awake and freed from what?
questions.explanation: "He is understood to be awake and to be freed from the false ego." (SB 3.27.14)

questions.question: Devahuti inquires: since material nature and the spirit soul are attracted to one another eternally, how is what possible?
questions.explanation: "Since one is attracted to the other eternally, how is their separation possible?" (SB 3.27.17)

questions.question: How can a living entity get liberation, according to Kapila's answer to Devahuti?

options.text: By seriously discharging devotional service unto Me

questions.explanation: "One can get liberation by seriously discharging devotional service unto Me and thereby hearing for a long time about Me or from Me." (SB 3.27.21)

questions.question: The influence of material nature can be removed by serious devotional service, just as what happens to the wooden sticks that cause a fire?

options.text: They are themselves consumed by it

questions.explanation: "This influence can be removed, just as wooden sticks which cause a fire are themselves consumed by it." (SB 3.27.23)

questions.question: By giving up his desire to lord it over material nature, the living entity becomes independent and does what?
questions.explanation: "By therefore giving it up, the living entity becomes independent and stands in his own glory." (SB 3.27.24)

questions.question: Why cannot the influence of material nature harm an enlightened soul, even though he engages in material activities?

options.text: Because he knows the truth of the Absolute, and his mind is fixed on the Supreme Lord
Because he lives in the forest

questions.explanation: "The influence of material nature cannot harm an enlightened soul, even though he engages in material activities, because he knows the truth of the Absolute, and his mind is fixed on the Supreme Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.27.26)

questions.question: After the mystic devotee gives up his present material body and goes to the transcendental abode, what happens?

options.text: He returns after a long time

questions.explanation: "After giving up the present material body, the mystic devotee goes to that transcendental abode and never comes back." (SB 3.27.28-29)

questions.question: When a perfect yogi's attention is no longer attracted to the by-products of mystic powers, what cannot overcome him?
questions.explanation: "His progress towards Me becomes unlimited, and thus the power of death cannot overcome him." (SB 3.27.30)

questions.question: The by-products of mystic powers are described as manifestations of what?
questions.explanation: "The by-products of mystic powers, which are manifestations of the external energy." (SB 3.27.30)

questions.question: "Avikaara" means without change. What is the unchanging position of a living entity?

options.text: Dovetail his energy with the Supreme Lord
Practicing devotional service under a bonafide spiritual master
Doing everything for Krsna without claiming proprietorship

questions.question: A main difference between the conditioned soul and a devotee is:

options.text: Conditioned soul does not own responsibility of his actions
Devotee owns responsibility of his actions
Devotee does not own responsibility of his actions

questions.question: One desiring material liberation (from birth and death) must turn to:
Because we've associated with material nature since time immemorial, we've grown accustomed to attachment with this temporary material nature.

options.text: Conditioned soul does not own responsibility of his actions
Devotee owns responsibility of his actions
Devotee does not own responsibility of his actions

questions.question: Consciousness acts in 3 stages under material conception. To become Krishna Conscious, one transcends these 3 stages, which are:
A pure devotee can realize the SPG's presence in everything by the reflection of His ______.
Identifying "everything in relationship to the body is mine" is ______, but identifying as eternal servitor of the Supreme Lord is ______.
Though a devotee appears merged in the 24 elements of matter, he is understood to be awake and free from ______.
Since material nature is eternally attracted to the spirit soul, how can the spirit soul be released?
"Aatmarama" means:

options.text: One who rejoices in the self
One fixed in spiritual activities in relationship with the Supreme soul
One who enjoys in the spiritual atmosphere
